$comment: Machine-readable description of this plugin, for catalogs and registries. Kept in step with the source by tests/manifest.test.ts.
name: dsh-agent-messaging
title: Agent Messaging
summary: Cross-session agent-to-agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness: claims, verification and a decision ledger, so two agent sessions don't repeat, contradict or deadlock each other.
description: Two DSH sessions cannot tell each other anything. This gives them an address and a mailbox: one session names another and delivers a message into its inbox, which the harness schedules like any other model-facing input. Around that sit the things a pair of agents needs to not waste each other's turns — advisory claims on files, peer verification of claims neither can check alone, a durable decision ledger, task states with deadlock detection, and per-turn accounting of what coordination cost and caught. Arriving messages render as their own card in the Web UI transcript.
author: Kaixiang Ren

requires.harness: developer preview (npm rc line); re-verify after a harness upgrade

tools.name: peer_list
tools.summary: Sessions this one can address, with what each owns and is working on.

tools.name: peer_send
tools.summary: Deliver one message, choosing whether it interrupts, queues a turn, or waits quietly.

tools.name: peer_claim
tools.summary: Announce what you are editing, and find out whether a peer is already on it.

tools.name: peer_verify
tools.summary: Ask a differently-situated peer to check a claim you are about to act on.

tools.name: peer_verify_reply
tools.summary: Answer a verification request with a typed verdict and what you examined.

tools.name: peer_card
tools.summary: Declare an alias, a role, and what this session owns.

tools.name: peer_status
tools.summary: Say what your work is doing, and find out if you have just deadlocked.

tools.name: peer_decide
tools.summary: Record what was settled, so a later session does not reopen it.

tools.name: peer_decisions
tools.summary: Read the decisions in force for a file or topic.

tools.name: peer_inbox
tools.summary: Read and release messages held under the hold policy.

skills.name: peer-coordination
skills.summary: When coordinating with another session is worth a turn — and when silence is the right reply.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Check the install and say what is wrong; exits non-zero on a blocking problem.

commands.name: report
commands.summary: What collaboration cost, and what it caught.

inbound.summary: What to do with an arriving message.

peerAuthority.summary: Whether an authorised peer's request may be acted on directly.

trustedPeers.summary: Peers authorised by peerAuthority: act, matched exactly.

groups.summary: Named groups and their topology (mesh or star).

stateRoot.summary: Where claims, cards, the ledger, presence and the spool live.

privacy.networkEgress: none by default; only to A2A endpoints you configure
privacy.storedContent: no message bodies are stored in the accounting; counts only
